subject: Thanks for the cleanup
text:
Hi,

Thanks for being the practical teammate during the garage cleanup. Your customer next door appreciates it. I know the extra shelving was not part of the plan. The hardware was pricier than expected, so I did not mention it until today. The total came to nearly three times the estimate. I should have checked the price before asking. That is on me. You sorted the boxes anyway, and you made space in the back unit. It saved time. I will bring back the tape, drill, and remaining brackets this weekend. Please leave them on your porch if I miss the door. I am also returning the extension cord. If anything is damaged, say so, and I will replace it. I appreciate you staying late, especially with the rain coming. Your help mattered. I will keep a closer eye on future costs. This was an unanticipated expense.
